subsystems.name: Host plant and gene construct
subsystems.role: turns the plant's own cellular machinery into a factory for a chosen protein.

subsystems.name: Gene delivery system
subsystems.role: gets the gene into leaf cells quickly (transient) or permanently (stable).

subsystems.name: Contained growing system
subsystems.role: produces biomass under controlled, contained conditions.

subsystems.name: Harvest and extraction
subsystems.role: releases the protein from leaf, seed or culture medium.

subsystems.name: Purification and quality control
subsystems.role: brings the protein to pharmaceutical or food grade.

subsystems.name: Containment and traceability
subsystems.role: keeps engineered plants and their genes out of the food and wild supply.

buildSteps.title: Choose the target and host
buildSteps.detail: Decide what protein is wanted — a therapeutic antibody, an enzyme, or a nutritional protein — and pick a host that makes it cheaply: Nicotiana benthamiana for fast leaf expression, cereal or legume seed for stable storage, or carrot or tobacco cells in suspension.

buildSteps.title: Design the gene construct
buildSteps.detail: The target gene is codon-optimised for the plant, given a strong promoter, and tagged with a signal peptide that routes the finished protein to the leaf apoplast, the seed, or out into the culture medium for easier recovery.

buildSteps.title: Introduce the gene
buildSteps.detail: Stable transformation inserts it into the plant genome via Agrobacterium, giving seed lines that pass the trait to their offspring. Transient expression instead infiltrates leaves with Agrobacteria carrying viral vectors, so the whole crop expresses the protein within days without any inherited change.

buildSteps.title: Grow the biomass
buildSteps.detail: Transient crops go into greenhouses or vertical farms for a few weeks; cell lines go into stirred-tank bioreactors, where the protein can be secreted into a defined medium and harvested continuously.

buildSteps.title: Harvest and extract
buildSteps.detail: Leaves are cut and homogenised, seeds are milled, or culture broth is drained. The crude extract is clarified by centrifugation and filtration to remove plant debris.

buildSteps.title: Purify
buildSteps.detail: Chromatography and precipitation steps isolate the target protein from the plant's thousands of other compounds, with viral-inactivation steps if the product is a medicine. This is the step where plant systems are hardest to make cheap.

buildSteps.title: Test and release
buildSteps.detail: Identity, potency, purity and glycan profile are measured against specification; medicines then need clinical trials, while food proteins go through safety and allergenicity assessment.

buildSteps.title: Scale out, not just up
buildSteps.detail: Unlike a steel fermenter, capacity grows by adding greenhouses or fields, so expansion is modular — but containment and consistency across many sites become the engineering problem.

prerequisites.why: without reliable Agrobacterium or biolistic transformation there is no engineered crop at all.
plants attach their own sugar patterns to proteins; human-compatible glycosylation usually requires knocking out plant-specific enzymes.
plant biomass carries phenolics, pigments and proteases that complicate downstream processing and raise cost.
engineered crops grown outdoors need rules and physical controls so they do not enter the food chain or wild populations.
greenhouse and vertical-farm capacity sets whether plant-made proteins can compete on cost.

pathway.milestone: approved niche medicines made in plant cells, plus tobacco-made antibodies used in outbreak response
pathway.unlocks: proof that plants can produce complex human proteins to specification.

pathway.milestone: transient-expression platforms scaled for rapid response, and a plant-made vaccine authorised
pathway.unlocks: weeks-scale production of vaccines and antibodies after a new pathogen emerges.

pathway.milestone: engineered seed crops supplying feed and food proteins at cost parity
pathway.unlocks: a land-efficient route to protein without livestock.

pathway.milestone: field-scale molecular farming with robust containment and identity-preserved supply chains
pathway.unlocks: regional manufacturing of biologics that does not depend on large stainless-steel plants.
